title: Staff
printHelp: Copy or print this private link for the invitee. It expires in seven days and can be used once.
photoHelp: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo (up to 10 MB). It will be resized before upload.
accessHelp: Grant access to an existing gym account, or invite a new account above. A profile alone grants no access. Owner access is managed separately.
revokeConfirm: Revoke this account's staff access? Its profile will be kept.
resetHelp: Requires 12–128 characters. Resetting ends all of this account's sessions.
error: Unable to save or load staff. Check your input and access, then try again.
conflict: This record changed. Reload staff before saving again.
forbidden: Only owners and admins can manage staff.
inviteDescription: You have been invited to join the gym staff. Accept this invitation within seven days.
invitationPassword: Choose a password (or enter your current password if you already have an account)
invitationError: Unable to accept this invitation. Check your name and password, or ask the gym for a new link if it is expired or already used.
invitationAccepted: Invitation accepted. You can now sign in.
javascriptRequired: Enable JavaScript to accept this invitation.
